# EKA2L1 dyncom subset for the initial 3DS CPU probe

Pinned upstream revision and source URL: REVISION.txt. Original headers and
GPL-3.0-or-later LICENSE are retained; individual source files also contain
Citra, Skyeye, ARM and SoftFloat provenance/notices. These sources are used in
the separate CPU probe, not the Java VM application.

Local changes:

* Make TRANS_CACHE_SIZE overrideable; both host and ARM11 builds use 8 MiB
  instead of the upstream 125 MiB default. Keep the upstream bounded-cache
  flush logic and its 2 MiB translation reserve.
* Use unsigned-int address temporaries for the RFE/SRS decoder callbacks, which
  take unsigned-int references. devkitARM newlib's uint32_t is unsigned long.
* Make VFP helper definitions match their uint32_t register-index declarations.
* Normalize single-VFP callback arguments to int, matching the shared callback
  table. int and int32_t are both 32-bit but distinct C++ types on devkitARM.

The standalone logging adapter is in native/symbian/compat/common/log.h. It
prints upstream diagnostic templates without argument interpolation; the probe
reports fault counts and check results separately. It is not the full upstream
logging framework. No phone firmware, Symbian kernel, installer, graphics or
audio services are included here. No SIS/APP execution is claimed.

Build with tools/build_symbian_cpu.py host|3ds. The original diagnostic guest
program is tests/symbian_cpu_guest.S, generated by tools/generate_symbian_guest.py.
The host integration probe runs ARM, Thumb, exclusive operations, VFP32/VFP64,
context switching and bounded scheduling. tools/build_symbian_probe.py builds
the equivalent Homebrew Launcher CPU/input test for a physical 3DS.
